about: Reviewed Tier-1 corpus groups whose errors are diagnosed CONTENT defects under the 1.93 loader, identical on both JS engines (proposed ADR-0047). A group listed here reports KNOWN instead of ERRORS only when its members' bytes match the pinned sha256s AND its error lines, timestamps stripped, equal expected_errors exactly as a multiset. Any new, changed or vanished line makes it KNOWNCHG, which fails the tier. Adding or editing an entry changes what a test accepts: it needs a diagnosis made without reading expansion content, a bead, and review.

entries.diagnosis: The five *-carrier entries are VISUAL EFFECTS (effectdata.plist) whose subentities name SHIP keys. OOShipRegistry -loadShipData runs -canonicalizeAndTagSubentities: once per dictionary, and the effect pass resolves subentity keys only within effectdata, so a ship key can never resolve there; the entries are dropped. Measured 2026-09-23 with shipData.load.progress and effectData.load.progress enabled by a loose AddOns/logcontrol.plist: all 10 lines fall between effectData 'Finished resolving like_effects...' and 'Finished cleaning up subentities...', none in the ship pass. The message says 'shipdata.plist entry' because the one routine serves both passes. Every named key exists in core Resources/Config/shipdata.plist, so this is not a missing dependency. The pre-migration loader (OOShipRegistry.m before seam 2.1) has the same two passes and the same message, so SpiderMonkey 1.93 fails identically (observed in tier-c-diff, oo-1gc.6). Author fix: define the carriers as ships, or give the effects effect subentities.
